purpose: Correct the earlier King-workbook interpretation and use the expanded King/profile corpus as a controlled new-parameter discovery mechanism.

preserved_findings: The exact 2000 workbook rows are structurally 80 domain containers x 25 repeated interrogation dimensions.
The scoring/ranking/loop-linkage R-F-R defects remain valid source findings.
correction_to_prior_review.corrected_overreach: The factorization of the workbook's 2000 rows does not imply that King/profile work cannot generate new native parameter candidates. Profile comparison, new evidence and residual explanatory gaps are explicitly allowed to propose new parameters.

parameter_discovery_gate.step_1: Activate existing parameters and combinations first.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_2: Record unexplained residuals instead of forcing a fit.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_3: Require a candidate to have a distinct definition, activation condition, measurable variation, negative boundary and falsifier.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_4: Seek support from another profile/case or independent evidence path; one weak anomaly is insufficient for broad promotion.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_5: Run exact-name and semantic-neighborhood comparison against the current 3204 Human-derived source registry for HUMAN_FUNCTIONAL candidates.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_6: Route candidates to HUMAN_FUNCTIONAL, ASI_REASONING or DOMAIN instead of mixing registries.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_7: Run R-F-R and user review. Candidate creation never changes the active 3204 count.
parameter_discovery_gate.step_8: Approved future adoption must create a new versioned source/registry; it may not mutate closed predecessor records.

source_truth_rule: Uploaded source claims and profile meanings are preserved as source-derived hypotheses. External historical truth is not inferred merely because a profile states it.
next: Run 3204 collision/nearest-neighbor probe, R-F-R candidate validation, then surface candidates for user review.
